_note: CRSP376 (S21, S2, DL-118, DL-20): the costly lanes of .github/workflows/ci.yml and lifecycle.yml. A lane is skipped only when main holds a pass record with the same inputs key (scripts/delivery/pass_records.py to-result); a lane with no inputs, a path that matches nothing or an uncommitted change under its inputs has no key and always runs. Keep the inputs wide: a missing path costs a skip that should not happen. The commands are part of the key; change them when the lane's steps change.
